5-Second Previews fixture

Hold Shift over a link for half a second. Every page here is synthetic and served from this loopback server only.

  • An article: a summary appears, and the server prints cookie=no referer=no.
  • Three redirects, then the article: a summary appears.
  • Four redirects: "The link redirected more than 3 times, so it wasn't previewed."
  • A redirect to the local network: "Previews aren't available for local network addresses."
  • A PDF: "This link is a PDF, not a web page."
  • An attachment: "This link downloads a file." No download starts.
  • A missing page: "The site answered with HTTP status 404."
  • A slow page: after 4 seconds, "The page took more than 4 seconds to load."
  • A page without text: "The page has no text to summarize."
  • A local network address: refused before anything is fetched.
